_meta.indication: Treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, nonrandomized, open-label, multi-cohort single-arm clinical trial
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations whose disease had progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Major efficacy outcome measure was overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR); DOR was an additional measure
pivotal_trials.n: 81 patients (primary efficacy population; prior platinum-based chemotherapy treated)
pivotal_trials.result: Confirmed ORR 40% (95% CI 29%, 51%); CR 3.7%, PR 36%; median DOR 11.1 months (95% CI 6.9, NE), 63% with DOR ≥6 months

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%): rash, IRR, paronychia, musculoskeletal pain, dyspnea, nausea, fatigue, edema, stomatitis, cough, constipation, and vomiting. Infusion-related reactions occurred in 66% of patients; ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 3.3% (0.7% Grade 3)
target_moa: First-in-class low-fucose human IgG1-based EGFR-MET bispecific antibody that simultaneously inhibits EGFR and MET, blocks ligand-induced activation, and recruits immune cells for antitumor activity
companion_dx_detail: Patient selection requires an FDA-approved test; in the efficacy population EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation status was determined by prospective local testing (tissue 94% and/or plasma 6%), and plasma samples from 96% of patients were tested retrospectively using Guardant360 CDx

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the Division did not refer the application because it did not raise significant public health, safety, or efficacy questions

requirement.text: 4070-4: Submit a summary of the final report of an analytical and clinical validation study to support labeling of a tissue-based in vitro diagnostic device essential to the safe and effective use of amivantamab-vmjw in NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations
